name: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: UKTBL is Spiko's AMF-authorized GBP money-market fund share token, backed by short-dated UK Treasury bills and gated through Spiko's transfer agent.
collateral: GBP-denominated UK Treasury bill money-market exposure administered through Spiko fund rails.
pegMechanism: GBP-denominated NAV-accreting money-market fund share; primary subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko at fund NAV.

jurisdiction.license: UCITS Short-Term VNAV Money Market Fund

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: UKTBL is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: UKTBL Ethereum mint/burn is gated by Spiko's UUPS PermissionManager. Its group-0 Safe can authorize minters and replace PermissionManager logic without a contract-enforced delay. Terminal mint and upgrade control chains are not enumerated for every non-Ethereum deployment.

controls.label: UKTBL token restricted mint/burn
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294990, implementation = 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, owner() = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 (renounced), authority() = 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 (PermissionManager). Mint and burn are restricted() calls requiring PermissionManager authorization.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager ADMIN Safe (3-of-8)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573477, Safe reads returned VERSION() = 1.4.1, eight owners, and threshold 3; existing PermissionManager review records no enabled modules or guard. Group 0 can administer PermissionManager permissions and its UUPS upgrade authorization, so it can authorize minters and replace mint-critical authority logic.

review.evidence: Ethereum contract and RPC evidence identifies the UUPS PermissionManager as UKTBL's authority path. At block 25573477, its group-0 Safe is 3-of-8; the PermissionManager implementation slot is 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e and the external proxy-admin slot is zero. Existing role evidence establishes group 2 operator contracts that can call UKTBL mint on Ethereum. The reviewed Spiko fund record is an AMF-regulated UCITS short-term VNAV money-market fund with quarterly PwC audit evidence, supporting periodic reconciliation and prudential supervision. The chain-local authority contract is identified for several EVM deployments, but terminal minter and upgrade control chains are not complete for every non-Ethereum deployment.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate terminal minter, administrator, and mint-logic upgrade controls for the Starknet and Stellar deployments, and reconcile the group memberships and UUPS authorization path for every non-Ethereum PermissionManager.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Spiko documents internal infrastructure for issuing, operating, and monitoring its regulated fund tokens across EVM networks, Starknet, and Stellar. For UKTBL, no independent bridge route was verified, so the route is reviewed as issuer-native multichain issuance.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)

sources.label: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund KID

reserveReview.rationale: The producer emits one 100% 'UK Treasury Bills and cash' identity. The KID and prospectus identify the referenced regulated fund, daily dealing, an explicit 180-day maximum residual maturity for eligible instruments, and a UK-government-instrument mandate. The prior 95/5 Treasury-bill and cash split was not a reported live allocation, so this review classifies the exact aggregate producer identity at the fund-share level.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact spiko-api single-asset identity cross-checked against Spiko's current product page, prospectus, KID, and share-class totals API
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No exposure outside the emitted aggregate fund identity is indicated. The producer does not publish separate live weights for Treasury bills and operational settlement cash, so no look-through split is authored.

sources.label: Spiko UK T-Bills Money Market Fund KID

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The KID identifies CACEIS Bank as custodian and states that the fund is separate from its management company and legally segregated from custodian assets; Spiko identifies HSBC as the UK Treasury-bill sub-custodian and GBP correspondent bank. Provider shares, the broader delegated-custody chain, and rehypothecation terms are not published.

notices.title: Low-liquidity fund token
notices.message: CoinGecko reports a live price and market cap but little or no secondary-market volume; Pharos treats UKTBL as a NAV-priced fund share.
